shared_elements: row of arched/crouching quadrupeds in profile along an upper register
band of vertical/hatched strokes (fringe or net-like pattern)
animals in profile facing the same direction
low relief carving on a rectangular stone face
register-based composition with animals below the divider
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: an upper register of repeated arched quadrupeds in profile marching in one direction, a horizontal divider carrying a fringe of short vertical/hatched strokes, and further animals in profile in the register below. The main difference is that B extends further with additional creatures (a bird-like figure and other animals) on a lower shaft not visible in A, but the shared register scheme and animal forms are highly specific rather than generic.
